title: The Name Answers
text: The name your House claimed has a face now. It sits at the end of the long table at supper, in House colors, and the servants set a place for it without being told. It has begun to ask for things.

options.label: Give it what it asks, a seat, a share, a room; it is of the House now.

outcomes.text: It is courteous and grateful. Gold appears in the strongroom that nobody put there.
At last it asks for one of your own and leads them by the hand into the room behind the wall. They come back a day later and will not speak of it.

options.label: Bring the priests and the salt to drive it out of the House.

outcomes.text: It goes screaming up the chimney. The ledger's page is blank again, and the House's claim with it.
It goes, taking the one who held the salt by the throat on its way out.

options.label: Do not look at the end of the table.

outcomes.text: It eats nothing and watches everyone. The House learns to eat quickly.
